sources.events: Each button = its endpoint (EP1, EP2). Presses arrive as genOnOff (0x0006) Tuya command 0xFD, payload press_type 0=single, 1=double, 2=long. No 0xEF00. Other TS0042 variants (0042TOPlusA) also expose 0xE000.
sources.battery: Do not bind / configure reporting on PowerConfiguration (0x0001): ZHA PR #2288 (TuyaNoBindPowerConfigurationCluster) — reporting setup drains the CR2032. Read passively only.
